resolution.note: sandbox mounts only system dirs, toolchain and named paths; test plants a host file and a checkout file unreadable inside bwrap, fails on the old ro-bind of /

title: Editing sessions cannot read host paths outside the unit base
body:
Astra audit E6 (confirmed, by design): the grading and session sandbox binds the host root read-only (evals/units/sandbox.ts:48-60), so a session can read host paths outside masked /tmp, /run and HOME, including other checkouts that may hold reference fixes.
Files: evals/units/sandbox.ts, test/evals/grader-isolation.test.ts
Outcome: an editing session sees only the unit base, the toolchain and scratch; hidden graders and reference fixes are unreadable from it; the test exits 0.
Proof: node --test test/evals/grader-isolation.test.ts passes, reading a planted host file fails inside the sandbox.
